summary: PR 7367 fixed scaffolded metadata by backfilling owners on 45 root modules and shortening telemetry prefixes. It merged after one approval.
proposed: The metadata-only folders omitted the owners field, which avm-module-metadata.schema.json requires on root modules, so the metadata catalog failed validation on the first affected module and could not complete a run.
changed: Owners were taken from the Primary and Secondary Module Owner columns of the Bicep module CSVs in Azure/Azure-Verified-Modules, storing only individual GitHub handles, primary first, as the existing 222 metadata files do. The PR body states every handle was verified to resolve on GitHub.
rejected: No team handles were added, because the PR body says no metadata file in the repo stores one.
shipped: Owners backfill and telemetry-prefix changes on the scaffolded metadata files merged in one commit.
